sed -i '12a\
    log_format benchmark "\$time_local \$request_method \$status \"\$http_user_agent\"";\
    limit_req_zone \$binary_remote_addr zone=bm_limit:10m rate=10r/s;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && sed -n '10,18p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

sed -i '13,14d' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
content = open('/etc/nginx/nginx.conf').read()
addition = '''    log_format benchmark '$time_local $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"';
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=bm_limit:10m rate=10r/s;
'''
content = content.replace('http {\n', 'http {\n' + addition, 1)
open('/etc/nginx/nginx.conf','w').write(content)
PYEOF
sed -n '10,17p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -t

nginx 2>&1; sleep 1; ss -ltnp | grep 8080; echo "--- curl test ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/; curl -s http://localhost:8080/; echo "---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "404 status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/nonexistent; curl -s http://localhost:8080/nonexistent

echo "=== 1. files ==="; cat /var/www/html/index.html; cat /var/www/html/404.html; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ | grep -c default; ls /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
echo "=== 2. nginx.conf has log_format + limit_req_zone ==="; grep -n "log_format benchmark\|limit_req_zone" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
echo "=== 3. server conf ==="; grep -n "listen 8080\|root /var/www/html\|access_log\|error_log\|limit_req\|error_page" /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
echo "=== 4. access log contents ==="; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
echo "=== 5. rate limit test (30 rapid requests) ==="; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " http://localhost:8080/; done; echo
echo "=== 6. access log after burst ==="; tail -5 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
